name: Anarchic Body
body:
School abjuration (chaotic); Level antipaladin 2, cleric 3, inquisitor 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 chaotic creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You touch a creature and its body becomes infused with chaotic obscurity.

The creature touched gains damage reduction 5/lawful.
